touchpoints.name: Métrica vista panel sistema transacción
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE error IS true SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Evento cloud rendimiento
touchpoints.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE 'web-%' FACET appName SINCE 1 hour ago

touchpoints.name: Servicios evento usuario estado entidad
touchpoints.query: SELECT sum(errorCount) FROM Transaction SINCE 1 hour ago

touchpoints.name: Registro estado
touchpoints.query: SELECT sum(errorCount) FROM Log WHERE duration > 0.5 FACET name SINCE 1 hour ago
